profile.name: Zaber电动精密位移台
profile.description: 这是一种用于精密线性定位与自动运动控制的电动位移台或单轴运动平台，可通过串口二进制协议进行控制。它常用于实验室中的光学元件、样品台或探针的位置调整、回零、定点移动和自动扫描。
profile.description_en: This is a motorized precision positioning stage or single-axis motion platform used for accurate linear positioning and automated motion control. It is commonly used in laboratories to position optical components, samples, or probes, including homing, point-to-point moves, and automated scanning.
